content: Tira kame, Kuateŋge sine ŋakmba wikina le sine nu tuku kuasmbi ndindo mineg. Nu Yesus kukulna le nu sine tuku pris suŋgo minit. Ta tuku siŋgine wamdus ŋakmba Yesus ndo idus tibe.
O buk Moses nu Kuate tuku mbal ŋgamukŋge piro ke mayemba minna. Taŋamba ndo Yesus nu Kuateŋge piro tuna ta nu piro ke mayena.
Nale arŋeŋ piro mayenaik ta Yesus nu Moses lite. Taŋgo ande wande pilit ta sine wande tuku nyu te-du ndaŋgeg. Sine taŋgo tuku nyu te-duŋgeg.
Wande ŋakmba taŋgoŋge patikade ta Kuate nu agaŋ ŋakmba tugu.
Moses nu piro taŋgo ndo Kuate tuku mbal ŋgamukŋge piro mayena. Kuate nu ŋgumneŋga wam kile-mayokkina ta nu wam ta tuku saka minna.

Kristus nu Kuate tuku Kiŋo minmba Kuate tuku mbal ŋgamukŋge piro mayena. Nu mbal ta tuku tugu. Sine wamdus saŋgrinu pilmba siŋgine Suŋgo tuku pasa alonu tairŋga minbe ta sine Kuate tuku mbal nu tuku wande taŋaŋ mineg.
Ŋgamuŋgal kilba tukul ndakam tuku pasa
Sine Tukul Guwa tuku pasa ise mayebe. Nu teŋenmba sana.

content.text: Kile ait te mbolŋge tane Kuate tuku pasa isig te
taŋgine mbuŋ Moses ndoŋ ma baknu mbolŋge minnaig taŋaŋ ŋgamuŋgal tukulmba kilba tukul ndakap.
Nane ye tuku wamdus mukuknu te gubra pile sam tuku tago-tagonaig.
Nane yar 40 ye tuku piro saŋgrinu yimyam kaŋgerkumba
ta tuku nda idusmba ye tago-tagoyumba minnaig.
Ta tuku ye mbal ta tuku gubra tumba nane tuku teŋenmba saken. Nane tuku wamdus tugusek kuga. Nane ye tuku maŋau katese ndade ŋgen.
Ye nane tuku gubra suŋgo tumba pasa saŋgrinumbi teŋenmba saken. Nane ye ndoŋ mabte nda ŋgen. Mune 95.7-11

content: Tukul Guwa nu taŋamba Kuate tuku miŋge pasa sakina.
Tira kame, tane riroŋ mayewap. Ande tane ŋgamukŋge wamdus tugusek kugatok minmba Kuate abo minmba minit nu talamba pitaiwikat.
Ki ait mindek taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu saŋgri pileniŋgap. Tane kile abo ŋak minig ait mbolŋge maŋau ta kusre ndawap. Tane taŋa ndawap ta une maŋau taŋge tane didikuwa le taŋgine ŋgamuŋgal tukulkikat.
Amboŋga sine Kristus wamdus ndindombi tigeŋ. Sine maŋau ta kusre ndamba taŋamba ndo minbe ta sine nu tugumŋge gare ŋak minamŋgig.
Kuate tuku pasa wam ta tuku teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Kile ait te mbolŋge tane Kuate tuku pasa isig te taŋgine mbuŋ kame taŋaŋ ŋgamuŋgal tukulmba kilba tukul ndawap ŋga sakate. Mune 95.7-11

content: Tane idusap. Ima kate ŋgamuŋgal tukulmba kilba tukulnaig e? Moses nu nane ŋakmba kilmba Isip kusremba kinaig mbal ta.
Ima kate tuku Kuate nu yar 40 mbolŋge gubra tina e? Nane wam ŋaigonu ke lika ma baknu mbolŋge kume farnaig mbal ta.
Ima kate tuku Kuate nu pasa saŋgrimbi nane ye ndoŋ mabte nda ŋgina e? Nane nu tuku pasa ismba dubi ndanaig mbal ta.
Nane Kuate talamba nu kumuŋ kuga ŋga idusnaig tukunu nane nu ndoŋ mabte ndakinaig.
